Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the chat last week. Attached is a first-pass rotational schedule (rotational_schedule_v1.xlsx) for the demo theater we discussed and a redline of the MDF term sheet (MDF-term-sheet-v3.pdf). Key asks on our side:

- Confirm whether PilotForge will provide a badge scanner and lead-capture integration with your Pardot instance, or whether Redwood should bring our handheld devices.
- Confirm AV rules for music and stage announcements (we want to avoid overlap with keynote hours).
- MDF: our proposed split is 60/40 (PilotForge/Redwood) on shared costs for demo staging, swag, and travel. Please flag any conflicts.

We're planning two 20-minute rotations per hour with 3 presenters total (one Redwood, two PilotForge) during the 10:00–16:00 show window. See the schedule tab for proposed rotations.

Can you review and let us know by Thursday so we can lock in floorplans and ship deadlines?

Thanks —
Markus

Hi Markus —

Appreciate the level of detail and the schedule draft. Quick notes after reviewing:

- Lead capture: PilotForge can provide an RFID badge-scanner and will export CSVs. We do not currently integrate with Pardot directly; we'll share the CSV each evening. If Redwood prefers to bring handheld scanners we can waive the equipment fee.
- AV: Music levels ok; no stage announcements during keynote blocks (12:00–13:00). We'll provide a local AV tech for pick-up/pack.
- MDF split: Carlos and I prefer a 50/50 split for demo staging and core booth fixtures; however, we're willing to take 65/35 on swag if Redwood covers shipping and customs paperwork.

I've attached the booth layout (pilotforge-booth_layout.png) and added inline comments to the schedule. Also flagging that demo laptop requests beyond 3 units will incur an additional venue charge.

Can you confirm who will be our billing contact for the MDF doc so we can route the PO?

Best,
Elena

On the splits: we can agree to 50/50 for staging and core fixtures. For swag we can accept 65/35 in your favor provided PilotForge takes responsibility for shipping customs and returns a shipping manifest to Redwood 10 days before the show.

Staffing/coverage: proposed on-site roster below (we'll adjust after you confirm presenters):
- Thu 10/22: Ben Carter (Redwood lead), PilotForge presenter A, PilotForge presenter B
- Fri 10/23: Vanessa Ortiz (Redwood lead), PilotForge presenter B, PilotForge presenter C
- Sat 10/24: Markus Klein (Redwood floater), PilotForge presenter A, PilotForge presenter C

2) Ben/Vanessa: can you confirm hardware needs (Ben: do we have 3 laptops spare + 1 hotspot?)
3) Elena/Carlos: sign the MDF term sheet via DocuSign (link below) once agreed.
